links.outcome: Clinician-graded completeness, correctness, clarity, empathy of LLM drafts versus care team on real messages
links.effect: RadOnc-GPT slightly outperformed the clinical care team in empathy and was comparable in completeness, correctness, and clarity; graders identified limitations including lack of context and hallucination.
links.quote: The RadOnc-GPT slightly outperformed the clinical care team in empathy, whereas achieving comparable scores with the clinical care team in completeness, correctness, and clarity.

unlisted_practices: Estimating time savings from LLM-drafted in-basket replies for nurses and clinicians

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a custom LLM (RadOnc-GPT) integrated with EHR data to draft responses to prostate cancer in-basket patient messages compared to actual care team responses.
